svg.title: Frankenstein system architecture
svg.desc: Four lanes share one append-only event stream, runs/live/events.jsonl. Lane A, the Lab, runs the referee on port 7101, builds the target (manifest, asm, ctx) and hosts the ASI:One agent. Lane B, the Crew, runs the Diggers on Muse Spark, the Checker, SubQ Snap judgment, a Gemini review, the MongoDB habit library, the jobs API on 7111 and the director on 7112. The Crew calls POST /check and POST /rebuild on the Lab; the ASI:One agent calls POST /jobs with the user's query. Lane D, the Creature, runs mGBA with a tap, the heal overlay, hot-swap and the phone page on 7401, reads fn.matched and build.rom, writes rom.swapped and sends heartbeats to the director. Lane C, the Stage, tails the stream to its scenes over ws 7202. The room watches the projector and plays on phones via a QR code.
svg.text: append-only · the only thing the lanes share
